description: REPLACE the Smart Links rules of one code — conditional redirects evaluated on every scan, first match wins, falling back to the code's primary destination when nothing matches. Typical uses: send iOS and Android scans to their own app stores, serve a Russian and a Kyrgyz page, or point at the delivery menu outside opening hours. The array you pass becomes the complete rule set, so read the current one with qrtap_get_smart_rules first; passing [] clears all rules. At most 5 rules.

codeId.description: The code id (UUID), as returned by qrtap_create_code, qrtap_create_codes_bulk or qrtap_list_codes. This is the internal id, not the short_url slug.

rules.description: The complete new rule set, max 5, evaluated top to bottom. Each rule is {"if": <condition>, "to": "<http/https url>"}. Pass [] to remove every rule.

if.description: Exactly one condition. Device: {"kind":"device","in":["ios","android","desktop","other"]}. Language: {"kind":"lang","in":["ru","ky"]} (primary subtags). Local time: {"kind":"hours","tz":"Asia/Bishkek","from":"09:00","to":"18:00","days":[1,2,3,4,5]} — 24h HH:MM, `to` exclusive, from>to crosses midnight, days are ISO weekdays 1=Mon..7=Sun and may be omitted for every day.

name: qrtap_set_smart_rules
